additional_info.subject: RE: 0399973 - ID0399973-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000697]After reboot charger is offline on SCB & OCPP CRM:02023000421
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000697
Charger ID/Serial No.:
TmguWp
Problem Description:
After reboot charger is offline on SCB & OCPP.
Unfortunately, we have limited ability to troubleshoot remotely without an SCB connection.
The best approach would be to have someone on-site to check the following:
Perform a local reboot, which can help bring the charger back online.
Verify if the router is connected to the internet.
Ensure the charger is powered on.
Once these checks are done, we can analyze the logs to determine why the outlets are offline. Additionally, please refer to the points below, which might explain why the charger is not on SCB:
There could be an internet issue with the Siemens router, and the WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to a failover function.
If the charger is connected to an OCPP server, a hard reset from "OCPP" or a local reboot may bring it back online.
Potential issues with the mobile network operator's data service, such as:
SIM card disabled or expired
Monthly data volume exhausted
Weak signal strength due to changed radio transmission conditions
IP not enabled for M2M contracts
Backend-related issues:
Settings for the affected charger may have changed on the backend.
The OCPP server on the backend side may be unavailable.
Teltonika-related issues:
The router may switch to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
A hardware failure in the router.
A software crash in the router.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 6/7/2024 as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
